newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans extend gains on exports, crush data.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans extend gains on exports, crush data.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures extended gains in early dealings on bullish input from the U.S. Department of Agriculture weekly export sales and a strong weekly crushing pace, traders said.
Demand was broad-based and included commission house and commercial buying centered in the January contract.
Iowa Grain, Refco Inc and Cargill Inc each bought one million bushels of January, traders said.
At 1023 CST, January soybeans jumped eight cents at $6.96-1/4 a bushel while the rest of the board was 4-3/4 to seven cents higher.
